title: AI Machine Learning Engineer
skills_required: MLOps, SQL, Databricks, MLflow, Power BI, Tableau, Azure ML, Model Lifecycle Management, Git, CI/CD, Python
jd_text:
Strong MLOps and production operations focus. Responsible for managing MLOps workflows, tools, and production support processes for ML solutions. Ensure stability, reliability, and performance of ML models and pipelines. Manage model lifecycle controls including versioning, lineage, reproducibility, monitoring, and governance.

MUST-HAVES:
- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or related field
- 8+ years experience with MLOps processes and tools
- Hands-on with MLflow, Databricks, Azure ML or equivalent cloud ML platforms
- Strong SQL and data analysis skills
- Experience with model lifecycle management
- Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, Databricks SQL dashboards
- Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD, scripting, production support
- Familiarity with ML and data development in telco environment
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management
- Job stability: min 2 years per organization
- Notice period: Immediate to 45 days

title: Platform Engineer

jd_text:
AI Platform Operations Engineer (L1) - part of the 24x7 operations team supporting the Central AI Kitchen platform and its AI services. Responsible for continuous monitoring, first-level incident detection and troubleshooting, execution of approved recovery procedures, and timely escalation.

Platform consists of AI services running on Red Hat OpenShift, hosted on on-prem infrastructure.

MUST-HAVES:
- Bachelor's in CS, IT, Engineering or related discipline
- OpenShift experience MANDATORY
- 5+ years IT operations, infrastructure, cloud or application support
- Basic Linux command-line knowledge
- Basic networking (IP addressing, DNS, ports, connectivity troubleshooting)
- Basic understanding of containers and Kubernetes concepts
- Willing to work in a 24x7 shift environment
- Good written and verbal communication skills

Design, develop, and scale production-grade AI/GenAI applications, including agentic systems and enterprise integrations.

Key responsibilities: build and deploy end-to-end AI and GenAI systems (RAG, agents, automation workflows); design APIs and microservices for scalable AI solutions; implement robust data pipelines and retrieval systems; optimize prompt engineering, evaluation, and model performance.

- Education: BE/BTech, ME/MTech, MCA, MSc (Computer Science)
- 6-8 years in software engineering/AI roles
- Min 5 years strong programming experience in Python (MUST)
- Min 3.5 years hands-on AI experience with LLMs, RAG pipelines, and AI frameworks
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
- Job stability: min 2 years per organization
- Notice period: Immediate to 45 days
